extracted.intended_audience: users of the PARI/GP library (mathematicians and developers) working with associative and central simple algebras over number fields
extracted.subtask_description: Reference for PARI/GP library functions to create, inspect, and manipulate associative algebras and central simple algebras (and related structures) over Q, Fp, and number fields, with detailed semantics, examples, warnings and library syntax.

rubrics_metrics.name: subgrouplist
rubrics_metrics.description: Given bnr (output of bnrinit) or a list of cyclic components of a finite abelian group G, outputs the list of subgroups of G as HNF left divisors of the SNF matrix corresponding to G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If flag = 0 (default) and bnr is from bnrinit, only subgroups whose modulus is the conductor are returned; otherwise modulus is ignored. If bound is a positive integer, restrict to subgroups of index < bound; if bound is a single-entry vector [B], return subgroups of index exactly B. Example outputs shown. Library syntax: GEN subgrouplist0(GEN bnr, GEN bound = NULL, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: algabsdim
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an algebra al (from alginit or algtableinit), returns the dimension of al over its prime subfield (Q or Fp).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: algabsdim(A) returns a long. Library syntax: long algabsdim(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algadd
rubrics_metrics.description: Given two elements x and y in an algebra al, computes their sum x + y in al.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices with coefficients in al. Example and library syntax: GEN algadd(GEN al, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: algalgtobasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an element x in a central simple algebra al (output by alginit), transforms it to a column vector on the integral basis of al (basis representation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is inverse of algbasistoalg. Example and library syntax: GEN algalgtobasis(GEN al, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: algaut
rubrics_metrics.description: For a cyclic algebra al = (L/K, σ, b) output by alginit, returns the automorphism σ (generator of Gal(L/K)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example returned as a polynomial expression. Library syntax: GEN algaut(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algb
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a cyclic algebra al = (L/K, σ, b) output by alginit, returns the element b ∈ K used to define the cyclic algebra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows b as a Mod element. Library syntax: GEN algb(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algbasis
rubrics_metrics.description: For a central simple algebra al (from alginit), returns a Z-basis of the order O0 stored in al (the natural order or a computed maximal order).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The basis is returned with fractional entries if needed. Library syntax: GEN algbasis(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algbasistoalg
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an element x in al in basis representation, transforms it to its algebraic representation in al (coefficients in center or splitting field).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is inverse of algalgtobasis. Example shows roundtrip. Library syntax: GEN algbasistoalg(GEN al, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: algcenter
rubrics_metrics.description: If al is a table algebra (algtableinit), returns a basis of the center over the prime field; if al is central simple (alginit), returns the center of al stored in al.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include diagonal matrices case and central simple algebra returning a polynomial for the center. Library syntax: GEN algcenter(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algcentralproj
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a table algebra al and a vector z of orthogonal central idempotents, returns algebras ali = zi * al for each idempotent; optionally returns quotient/projection/lift data when maps = 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show decomposing F2 ⊕ F4. Returns t_VEC [al1,...,aln] or with maps a t_VEC [quo, proj, lift] for each. Library syntax: GEN alg_centralproj(GEN al, GEN z, long maps).

rubrics_metrics.name: algchar
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the characteristic of the algebra al (0 for number-field algebras or p for Fp algebras).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example uses algtableinit with p=13. Library syntax: GEN algchar(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algcharpoly
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an element b in al, returns its characteristic polynomial: absolute characteristic polynomial for table algebras (Fp[v] or Q[v]) or reduced characteristic polynomial for central simple algebras (K[v], K=center).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices with coefficients in al. Parameter v optionally selects variable number. Library syntax: GEN algcharpoly(GEN al, GEN b, long v = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: algdecomposition
rubrics_metrics.description: For a table algebra al, returns [J, [al1,...,aln]] where J is a basis of the Jacobson radical and al1,...,aln are the simple factors of the semisimple algebra al/J.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN alg_decomposition(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algdegree
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a central simple algebra al (from alginit), returns the degree d of al (square root of its dimension over center).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example returns 2. Library syntax: long algdegree(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algdim
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the dimension of al: for central simple algebra (alginit) dimension over its center; for table algebra (algtableinit) dimension over its prime subfield.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: algdim(A) returns 4. Library syntax: long algdim(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algdisc
rubrics_metrics.description: For a central simple algebra al (alginit), computes the discriminant of the order O0 stored in al: determinant of the trace form Tr: O0 × O0 → Z.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show how to compute via alghassef etc. Library syntax: GEN algdisc(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algdivl
rubrics_metrics.description: Given x and y in al, computes a left quotient z such that x * z = y (non-unique if x is a zero divisor); assumes y is left-divisible by x.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If x invertible this equals x^{-1} y. Also accepts matrices. Library syntax: GEN algdivl(GEN al, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: algdivr
rubrics_metrics.description: Given x and y in al, computes x * y^{-1} (right division).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices. Library syntax: GEN algdivr(GEN al, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: alggroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Initialize the group algebra K[G] over K = Q (or Fp if specified) where G is from a galoisinit structure or a t_VEC of permutations closed under products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows checking semisimplicity. Library syntax: GEN alggroup(GEN gal, GEN p = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: alghasse
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a central simple algebra al and a place pl (prime ideal or integer between 1 and r1+r2), returns the local Hasse invariant h at that place (a t_FRAC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show invariants at finite and infinite places. Library syntax: GEN alghasse(GEN al, GEN pl).

rubrics_metrics.name: alghassef
rubrics_metrics.description: For a central simple algebra al, returns [PR, hf] describing local Hasse invariants at finite places: PR is a list of primes and hf is a vector of integers modulo degree d.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows returned PR and Vecsmall of hf. Library syntax: GEN alghassef(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: alghassei
rubrics_metrics.description: Given al, returns a t_VECSMALL hi of r1 integers modulo degree d giving the local Hasse invariants at the infinite (real) places.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example returns Vecsmall([1,0]). Library syntax: GEN alghassei(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algindex
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the index of the central simple algebra A over K (degree e of unique central division algebra D with A ≃ M_d(D)); if pl provided, returns local index at place pl.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show local and global indices. Library syntax: long algindex(GEN al, GEN pl = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: alginit
rubrics_metrics.description: Initialize a central simple algebra (or algebra) defined by data B and C (and optional variable v, flag) in several supported modes: multiplication table over a base field K; cyclic algebra given by rnf and [sigma,b]; quaternion special case [a,b]; algebra defined by local Hasse invariants [d, [PR,hf], hi]; or matrix algebra via integer d.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each mode has specific input formats and requirements (e.g., multiplication table must have e1=1 and be integral; cyclic algebra b must be integral; Hasse invariants must sum to 0). By default computes a maximal order (expensive); set flag=0 to prevent that. The returned object stores splitting field, Hasse invariants, bases, multiplication tables, characteristic, and other metadata. Library syntax: GEN alginit(GEN B, GEN C, long v = -1, long flag). Numerous examples and warnings provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: alginv
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an element x in al, computes its inverse x^{-1} (assumes x invertible).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices with coefficients in al. Library syntax: GEN alginv(GEN al, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: alginvbasis
rubrics_metrics.description: For a central simple algebra al, returns a Z-basis of the natural order in al with respect to the order O0 stored in al.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example returns integer and negative entries. Library syntax: GEN alginvbasis(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algisassociative
rubrics_metrics.description: Checks whether a provided multiplication table mt is suitable for algtableinit (i.e., mt is a t_VEC of n matrices giving left multiplications, e1=1, and ei(ej ek) = (ei ej) ek for all i,j,k).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be used to check a posteriori an algebra. mt as output by algtableinit is allowed. Parameter p ignored. Returns 1 if associative, 0 otherwise. Library syntax: GEN algisassociative(GEN mt, GEN p).

rubrics_metrics.name: algiscommutative
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether algebra al (table or central simple) is commutative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show both commutative and non-commutative cases. Library syntax: GEN algiscommutative(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algisdivision
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a central simple algebra al, tests whether al is a division algebra; if pl provided, tests whether al is locally a division algebra at that place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show local/global checks. Library syntax: GEN algisdivision(GEN al, GEN pl = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: algisdivl
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether y is left-divisible by x in al (i.e., there exists z with x z = y); if &z provided sets z to such element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices. Example shows usage and setting z. Library syntax: GEN algisdivl(GEN al, GEN x, GEN y, GEN *z = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: algisinv
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether x in al is invertible; if &ix provided sets ix to inverse of x.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices. Example demonstrates returned inverse. Library syntax: GEN algisinv(GEN al, GEN x, GEN *ix = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: algisramified
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether al is ramified (not isomorphic to a matrix algebra over its center); if pl provided, tests ramification locally at place pl.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show local/global ramification checks. Library syntax: GEN algisramified(GEN al, GEN pl = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: algissemisimple
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether algebra al (table or central simple) is semisimple (i.e., Jacobson radical trivial).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: algissemisimple returns 0 or 1. Library syntax: GEN algissemisimple(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algissimple
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether algebra al is simple. If ss = 1, assumes al is semisimple without testing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples demonstrate effect of ss flag. Library syntax: GEN algissimple(GEN al, long ss).

rubrics_metrics.name: algissplit
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether a central simple algebra al is split (isomorphic to a matrix algebra over its center); if pl provided tests locally at that place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show local/global split tests. Library syntax: GEN algissplit(GEN al, GEN pl = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: alglathnf
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an algebra al and a square invertible matrix m of size equal to dim(al), returns the lattice generated by the columns of m (in HNF form).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows retrieving an entry of the HNF. Library syntax: GEN alglathnf(GEN al, GEN m).

rubrics_metrics.name: algleftmultable
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an element x in al, computes its left multiplication table: returns an n×n matrix where n is length of t_COL representing x; uses integral basis or algebraic basis according to representation of x.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts square matrices with coefficients in al. Library syntax: GEN algleftmultable(GEN al, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: algmul
rubrics_metrics.description: Given two elements x and y in al, computes their product x * y in al.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices with coefficients in al. Library syntax: GEN algmul(GEN al, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: algmultable
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns multiplication table(s) of al over its prime subfield: if al from algtableinit returns table used to define al; if from alginit returns the multiplication table of stored order O0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returned as t_VEC of t_MAT (left multiplication tables of basis elements). Library syntax: GEN algmultable(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algneg
rubrics_metrics.description: Given element x in al, computes its additive inverse −x.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices with coefficients in al. Library syntax: GEN algneg(GEN al, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: algnorm
rubrics_metrics.description: Given x in al, returns its norm: absolute norm for table algebras (Fp or Q output), reduced norm for central simple algebras (element of center).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts square matrices with coefficients in al. Example returns element in base field. Library syntax: GEN algnorm(GEN al, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: algpoleval
rubrics_metrics.description: Given b in al and polynomial T in K[X], computes T(b) in al.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN algpoleval(GEN al, GEN T, GEN b).

rubrics_metrics.name: algpow
rubrics_metrics.description: Given element x in al and integer n, computes x^n in al.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices. Example shows powering. Library syntax: GEN algpow(GEN al, GEN x, GEN n).

rubrics_metrics.name: algprimesubalg
rubrics_metrics.description: For a semisimple table algebra (algtableinit) of positive characteristic, returns a basis of the prime subalgebra fixed by the Frobenius automorphism of the center (abstractly isomorphic to product of Fp).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example returns small basis. Library syntax: GEN algprimesubalg(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algquotient
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a table algebra al and I a basis matrix of a two-sided ideal of al, returns the quotient algebra al/I; if flag=1 also returns [al/I, proj, lift] with projection and section matrices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example demonstrates reducing dimension and retrieving algdim. Library syntax: GEN alg_quotient(GEN al, GEN I, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: algradical
rubrics_metrics.description: For a table algebra al (algtableinit), returns a basis of the Jacobson radical of al over its prime field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include Q[x]/(x^2) and 2×2 upper triangular matrices. Library syntax: GEN algradical(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algramifiedplaces
rubrics_metrics.description: For a central simple algebra al, returns a t_VEC listing places of the center that are ramified in al (each place as integer index or prime ideal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example returns both infinite place index and prime ideal. Library syntax: GEN algramifiedplaces(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algrandom
rubrics_metrics.description: Given algebra al and integer b, returns a random element of al with coefficients in [-b,b].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN algrandom(GEN al, GEN b).

rubrics_metrics.name: algrelmultable
rubrics_metrics.description: For a central simple algebra al defined by a multiplication table over its center K, returns that multiplication table (the relative multiplication table).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show comparing returned matrices to original mt. Library syntax: GEN algrelmultable(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algsimpledec
rubrics_metrics.description: For a semisimple algebra (algtableinit), returns [al1, al2, ..., aln] such that al ≃ ⊕ al_i; if flag=1 returns for each component [ali, proji, lifti] with projection and section matrices. Factors sorted by increasing dimension then center dimension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warning: images of lifts are not guaranteed to form a direct sum. Ordering deterministic over finite fields but not necessarily over Q. Library syntax: GEN algsimpledec(GEN al, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: algsplittingdata
rubrics_metrics.description: For a central simple algebra al defined by a multiplication table over its center K, returns data [t, Lbas, Lbasinv]: element t generating a maximal subfield L = K(t), matrix Lbas expressing an L-basis of al on integral basis, and Lbasinv expressing integral basis on that L-basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows sizes of returned matrices. Library syntax: GEN algsplittingdata(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algsplittingfield
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the splitting field of a central simple algebra al as an rnf structure stored in al (relative extension of the center).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows polynomial for splitting field. Library syntax: GEN algsplittingfield(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algsplittingmatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a central simple algebra al and element x, returns the matrix φ(x) under stored isomorphism φ: A ⊗_K L → M_d(L) where L is an extension with [L:K]=d.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices with coefficients in al. Library syntax: GEN algsplittingmatrix(GEN al, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: algsqr
rubrics_metrics.description: Given element x in al, computes its square x^2 in al.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts square matrices with coefficients in al. Library syntax: GEN algsqr(GEN al, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: algsub
rubrics_metrics.description: Given two elements x and y in al, computes their difference x − y in al.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices. Library syntax: GEN algsub(GEN al, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: algsubalg
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a table algebra al and B a basis matrix of a subalgebra of al, returns an algebra isomorphic to B.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows algdim of original and subalgebra. Library syntax: GEN algsubalg(GEN al, GEN B).

rubrics_metrics.name: algtableinit
rubrics_metrics.description: Initialize an associative algebra over K = Q (or Fp) defined by multiplication table mt: mt should be t_VEC of n matrices in M_n(K) giving left multiplication by basis elements e1=1,...,en; assumes integral table for K = Q.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use algtableinit to input finite-dimensional K-algebra to compute radical and split quotient into simple factors. The returned object stores characteristic, multiplication table, and traces. For central simple algebras prefer alginit. Library syntax: GEN algtableinit(GEN mt, GEN p = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: algtensor
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute tensor product of two algebras al1 and al2. For central simple algebras only implemented for cyclic algebras of coprime degree over same center K; for alginit computes a maximal order by default (suppress with maxord=0).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN algtensor(GEN al1, GEN al2, long maxord).

rubrics_metrics.name: algtrace
rubrics_metrics.description: Given element x in al, computes its trace: absolute trace for table algebras (Fp or Q), reduced trace for al from alginit (element of center).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts matrices. Example and library syntax: GEN algtrace(GEN al, GEN x).
